captions.detailed: A front-loading washing machine featuring a light gray rectangular cabinet body. The front face includes a circular porthole door with a thick dark gray frame and a light blue glass window, a small black cylindrical program selector knob on the upper-left, and a rectangular detergent drawer panel on the upper-right. The porthole door is designed to swing open on a left-side hinge, the detergent drawer slides forward, and the internal drum revolves horizontally.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a front-loading washing machine with a light gray rectangular cabinet. It must include a circular porthole door with a dark frame and glass center hinged on the left, a sliding rectangular detergent drawer on the top right, a rotating black program selector knob on the top left, and a horizontal rotating internal drum.
captions.factory: Construct the main cabinet body using a box primitive. Create the detergent drawer as a separate box with a prismatic joint sliding along the Y-axis. Model the program selector knob as a cylinder with a revolute joint on the Y-axis. Create the circular porthole door by combining a ring for the frame and a thin cylinder for the glass, attaching it to the cabinet via a revolute joint on the Z-axis. Finally, model the internal drum as a cylinder with a continuous revolute joint rotating on the Y-axis.
